jobs_results.description:
Hindi Translator jobs in Delhi at CryptoMize are open on a rolling, always-hiring basis — Hindi is our highest-volume language surface, and capacity is staffed ahead of engagements, not after. This is a full-time, permanent position with immediate joining at our New Delhi HQ, inside the linguistics cell that serves political, reputation, and intelligence engagements across the Hindi belt and beyond. Experienced Hindi-to-English and English-to-Hindi professionals will find the complete job description below: responsibilities owned from day one, requirements, seniority path, and selection process.

What you will actually do:

Hold sign-off on Hindi-English deliverables for the electoral book — speeches, rally material, and booth-level literature carrying your review markRule on register per audience: the rhetorical Hindi a rally demands against the everyday Hindi a booth volunteer reads, each choice defended at reviewGovern parallel terminology for electoral and administrative vocabulary across the Hindi belt’s state-by-state variationSkills that matter: Native Hindi at sign-off authority, Rhetorical versus everyday register arbitration, State-by-state electoral vocabulary governance, Devanagari production quality at volume, Code-switch preservation judgment, Hindi media-cycle monitoring for engagements.

Tools you will use: SDL Trados Studio, memoQ translation memory and terminology, TermBase glossary management, Xbench-class QA tooling.

Location: New Delhi (HQ), E4, Vasant Vihar. Type: full-time permanent. Availability: immediate, rolling intake. Compensation: discussed at screening. Apply: https://cryptomize.com/careers/job-openings/apply/

jobs_results.title: Chinese-English / Chinese-Hindi Translator
jobs_results.description:
Position: Chinese-English / Chinese-Hindi Translator

Department: Projects / Engineering

Location: As per Project Requirement

Reporting To: Project Manager / Project Head

Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a fluent translator with expertise in Chinese-English or Chinese-Hindi translation, specifically for technical and construction documents. The candidate will be responsible for providing translation and interpretation for project meetings, translating technical documents and drawings, and facilitating effective communication between Chinese and local teams.

Key Responsibilities

● 1. Translation Services

○ Provide accurate translation of technical and engineering documents.

○ Translate project specifications, drawings, reports, and correspondence.

○ Translate meeting minutes, project communications, and official documents.

○ Ensure technical terminology accuracy and project-specific terminology consistency.

● 2. On-Site Interpretation

○ Provide real-time interpretation for project meetings, site discussions, and coordination activities.

○ Facilitate communication between Chinese project teams and local teams.

○ Assist in technical discussions and problem-solving sessions.

○ Ensure clear and accurate communication of complex technical information.

● 3. Technical Document Translation

○ Handle translation of engineering documents, technical drawings, and blueprints.

○ Translate HVAC, electrical, ELV, and architectural technical specifications.

○ Prepare translated versions of quality reports, test results, and commissioning documents.

○ Maintain accuracy of technical measurements, dimensions, and specifications.

● 4. Project Communication Support

○ Assist in communication between Chinese management and local project teams.

○ Prepare translated project instructions and procedural documents.

○ Support safety training and induction sessions with translation assistance.

○ Facilitate vendor and subcontractor communications.

● 5. Documentation & Records

○ Maintain translation records and documentation accuracy.

○ Prepare translated versions of project handover documentation.

○ Support preparation of bilingual project reports and communications.

○ Ensure consistency of terminology across all translated documents.

● 6. Quality Assurance

○ Verify accuracy and completeness of all translations.

○ Ensure technical terminology is correctly interpreted.

○ Maintain confidentiality of project information.

○ Coordinate with project teams to clarify technical details when needed.

Required Technical Skills

● Chinese-English Translation

● Chinese-Hindi Translation

● Technical Document Translation

● Engineering Drawing Translation

● Simultaneous Interpretation Skills

● Construction & Engineering Terminology

● HVAC Systems Knowledge

● Electrical Systems Knowledge

● Project Management Terminology

● Quality Report Translation

● Commissioning Document Translation

● Microsoft Office Proficiency

● CAD Drawing Interpretation

● Cross-Cultural Communication

Education

● Bachelor's degree or above

Experience

● Demonstrated experience in technical and engineering translation.

● Minimum 2 years of construction or industrial project translation experience.

● Strong verbal and written translation skills with high accuracy standards.

Language Requirements

● Fluent in Chinese and English or Chinese and Hindi - MANDATORY

● Native or near-native proficiency in both languages required

● Strong English communication skills (written and verbal)

● Technical English terminology knowledge for construction and engineering

Interview Details

● Interview Mode: Face-to-Face

● Location Preference: Candidates from nearby/local locations are strongly preferred

## Language Translator (Spanish, Russian, Mandarin Chinese, Hindi)

This role involves providing high-quality translation and interpretation services across multiple languages. The successful candidate will be responsible for accurately conveying information between languages, ensuring clarity and cultural sensitivity in all communications. This position requires a strong command of the specified languages and excellent communication skills.

**Key Responsibilities:**

*   Translate written materials from various languages into English and vice versa.
*   Provide simultaneous and consecutive interpretation during meetings and conferences.
*   Ensure accuracy and consistency in translations, adhering to established terminology and style guides.
*   Maintain confidentiality of sensitive information.
*   Collaborate with subject matter experts to ensure accurate translation of technical or specialized content.

**Requirements/Qualifications:**

*   Fluency in Spanish, Russian, Mandarin Chinese, and Hindi.
*   Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
*   Proven experience in translation and interpretation.
*   Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
*   Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
*   Proficiency in translation software and tools.

jobs_results.company_name: The Class Of One - Global Online School
jobs_results.description:
Company Description The Content provider is focused on transforming traditional learning structures and building the content for the future through innovative, technology-enabled education. it aims to make high-quality learning accessible, flexible, and engaging for students across diverse geographies. Team members join a mission-driven organization committed to reimagining education for the next generation of learners.




Role Description This is an on-site Hindi and Tamil Transcription Expert role based in Noida. The transcription expert will listen to audio and video content in Hindi and Tamil and accurately convert it into written text, ensuring proper grammar, spelling, and formatting. Day-to-day responsibilities include reviewing and editing transcripts, maintaining consistency with style guidelines, and verifying the accuracy of spoken content, including educational terminology. The role also involves collaborating with content creators and academic teams to support the development of learning materials, subtitles, and documentation in Hindi and Tamil. The expert will manage transcription files, meet project deadlines, and help maintain high quality standards for multilingual resources.

Qualifications

Strong proficiency in Hindi and Tamil, with excellent listening, comprehension, and writing skills in both languages.Demonstrated experience in transcription, with the ability to produce accurate, well-formatted written documents from audio and video sources.Excellent attention to detail, including strong command of grammar, spelling, punctuation, and formatting standards.Familiarity with educational content or e-learning environments, preferably in a school or academic setting.Comfort with using computers, transcription tools, and basic productivity software for document creation and management.Strong time management skills and the ability to work on-site in Noida, meeting deadlines and handling multiple assignments.Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with educators, content developers, and operations staff.Relevant academic background in languages, linguistics, education, or a related field is preferred; prior transcription experience is an advantage. .
